fee_notes: Royalty is 6% of total net sales (weekly); late fee of $25/week plus 1.5%/month interest on overdue amounts. National Advertising Fund currently 2% of net sales with right to increase to 4%. Local Advertising is an additional 2% of net sales spent on franchisee's own approved advertising. Brand Technology System Support Services: $840-$1,500/year for mandatory services plus up to $3,250/year for optional services (paid quarterly). Additional Training reimbursement up to $1,500/week per individual after first 5 persons trained free. Co-brand (Marble Slab Creamery) net sales included in royalty base with licensor's share remitted separately.
